'''The Canals''' are the areas between the four quarters of the [[Undercity]]. A river of green "liquid" flows in a large channel around the quarters in a circular path.

==Notes==
*You can fish in it; you get normal low-level fish, plus things like [[Old Skull]] or [[Sickly Looking Fish]], as well as [[Old Teamster's Skull]].
*The [[Shaman]] ability [[Water Walking]] doesn't work on the canals.
